source_caption_text:
Ye really refusing to blink at all costs 😂🔥

Busta Rhymes brought together a stacked lineup for “Thank You” in 2013, featuring Q-Tip, Kanye West and Lil Wayne. Built around a sample of Alicia Myers’ “I Want to Thank You,” the track has a feel-good, old-school hip-hop sound, with Busta and Q-Tip trading verses over the soulful production.

While Lil Wayne opens the track with a short intro, Kanye’s contribution comes through in background vocals and ad-libs rather than a full verse. His appearance in the music video is hard to miss, especially during the moments where he looks like he’s desperately trying not to blink. His eyes are watering, but he keeps holding them open.

It’s a small moment that makes the video even more entertaining, especially when you notice it. Between the all-star lineup and Busta and Q-Tip’s chemistry, “Thank You” brought together some major names for a memorable collaboration.
